title: Alpha CRDs are still served — 0.35 will not read them
quote: `0.33.0`+ _only_ supports Karpenter v1beta1 APIs and will not work with existing Provisioner, AWSNodeTemplate or Machine alpha APIs. Do not upgrade to `0.35.0`+ without first upgrading to `0.32.x`. This version supports both the alpha and beta APIs, allowing you to migrate all of your existing APIs to beta APIs without experiencing downtime.
remediation: Upgrade to 0.32.x first and migrate every alpha object to the v1beta1 APIs before coming here.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group | test("karpenter")) | "\(.metadata.name) served=\([.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(","))"'  # each Karpenter CRD and the API versions it still serves

title: Re-enabled webhooks need ports 8000, 8001, 8081 and 8443 reachable

detection.reason: whether a NetworkPolicy actually blocks these ports for the Karpenter pods depends on the policy's selectors and rules, which are not part of the collected projection

quote: Webhooks have been re-enabled by default starting in `0.35.8` to faciliate migration to `v1.0`. If your cluster has network policies that block Ingress then ports `8000`, `8001`, `8081`, `8443` will need to be allowlisted. You may still choose to disable webhooks through the helm chart.
remediation: Karpenter re-enables its webhooks from 0.35.8. Allowlist ports 8000, 8001, 8081 and 8443 for the Karpenter namespace in any NetworkPolicy that restricts ingress.
verifyCommand: kubectl get networkpolicy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) types=\((.spec.policyTypes // []) | join(","))"'  # check any policy in the Karpenter namespace against ports 8000, 8001, 8081 and 8443
